# SEO & GEO Studio — Comprehensive LLM Context & Specifications

> Hospitality Search Engine and Generative Engine Optimization Suite with Real-Time Character and Pixel Budgeting, Dynamic Schema Ingestion, and Multi-Format Export Engines.

Canonical Origin: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/nurunnobejisan/SEO-Studio

## System Overview
SEO & GEO Studio is an enterprise-grade web application and browser extension suite designed specifically for hospitality brands (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, independent boutique luxury properties, and management groups). It enforces strict character boundaries (Title: 50–60 characters; Description: 145–155 characters), physical Arial desktop pixel limits (Title <= 580px; Description <= 920px), Schema.org semantic entity graph generation, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) direct answer structures.

---

## 78-Keyword Hospitality Strategy Matrix
URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/strategy-matrix
Coverage: 6 intent tiers across Brand Direct, Local Hyper-Targeted, Amenities & Dining, MICE Meetings & Weddings, Extended Stay & Corporate Housing, and Generative AI Search Queries.

## Full Catalog of 12 Production SEO & GEO Templates

### 1. Core Web Vitals & PageSpeed Technical Audit
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/technical-seo/core-web-vitals-audit
- Category: Technical SEO Audits
- Difficulty: Advanced | Est. Time: 2.5 hours
- Schema: TechArticle
- Direct Answer: A Core Web Vitals audit identifies bottlenecks affecting Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). By optimizing hero images, deferring non-critical JavaScript, and establishing explicit container dimensions, websites achieve a 100% green assessment in Google PageSpeed Insights.

### 2. JavaScript Rendering & DOM Hydration Diagnostics
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/technical-seo/javascript-rendering-hydration
- Category: Technical SEO Audits
- Difficulty: Advanced | Est. Time: 3 hours
- Schema: TechArticle
- Direct Answer: JavaScript rendering diagnostics evaluate disparities between raw HTML responses and fully hydrated DOM states. Ensuring booking engine widgets, price calendars, and room descriptions render server-side or via static generation prevents search bot rendering timeouts and indexing omissions.

### 3. Luxury Hotel Landing Page Content Brief
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/on-page-seo/hotel-landing-page-brief
- Category: On-Page Content Briefs
- Difficulty: Intermediate | Est. Time: 2 hours
- Schema: Article
- Direct Answer: A luxury hotel landing page content brief aligns commercial search intent with guest booking behaviors. Structuring copy around verified amenities, high-resolution visual anchors, location proximity indicators, and direct-booking incentives ensures high conversions while satisfying Google helpful content criteria.

### 4. Keyword Cannibalization Mapping & Remediation Matrix
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/on-page-seo/keyword-cannibalization-matrix
- Category: On-Page Content Briefs
- Difficulty: Intermediate | Est. Time: 1.5 hours
- Schema: TechArticle
- Direct Answer: Keyword cannibalization occurs when multiple hotel landing pages compete for identical search queries, diluting domain authority and confusing search engines. Establishing clear URL intent hierarchies, consolidated 301 redirects, and targeted internal anchor links restores definitive organic ranking signals.

### 5. Google Business Profile Multi-Property Master Checklist
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/local-seo/gbp-multi-property-optimization
- Category: Local SEO & GBP Checklists
- Difficulty: Intermediate | Est. Time: 2 hours
- Schema: LocalBusiness
- Direct Answer: Optimizing multi-property Google Business Profiles requires precise primary category selection, exact UNAP alignment, geo-tagged photography, real-time amenity attributes, and active review response protocols to maximize 3-pack visibility across high-intent traveler local search clusters.

### 6. UNAP Consistency & Local Citation Hygiene Audit
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/local-seo/unap-local-citation-audit
- Category: Local SEO & GBP Checklists
- Difficulty: Beginner | Est. Time: 1.5 hours
- Schema: LocalBusiness
- Direct Answer: UNAP consistency audits verify that a hotel's Name, Address, Phone number, and Website URL are identical across Tier 1 directories, OTAs, mapping aggregators, and social profiles. Resolving legacy discrepancies directly boosts local proximity rankings in Google Maps.

### 7. Dynamic Location Landing Pages Scalable Architecture
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/programmatic-seo/dynamic-location-landing-pages
- Category: Programmatic SEO Blueprints
- Difficulty: Advanced | Est. Time: 4 hours
- Schema: SoftwareApplication
- Direct Answer: Programmatic location landing pages generate high-intent destination guides programmatically without thin-content penalties. By injecting proprietary property data, verified neighborhood drive-times, and authentic amenity checklists, hotel groups capture thousands of long-tail geographical queries.

### 8. Hotel Amenities & Experiences Matrix Programmatic Blueprint
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/programmatic-seo/hotel-amenities-matrix-blueprint

- Difficulty: Intermediate | Est. Time: 2.5 hours

- Direct Answer: The amenities programmatic matrix transforms unstructured hotel facility data into indexed experiential landing pages. Covering pet policies, EV charging stations, rooftop bars, and spa packages, this architecture secures top-of-funnel amenity searches directly ahead of OTAs.

### 10. Unlinked Brand Mention Reclamation & Partner Link Engine

- Direct Answer: Unlinked brand mention reclamation converts existing press citations, wedding blog vendor tags, and conference organizer listings into authoritative follow backlinks through polite, value-driven outreach providing updated URLs and high-resolution assets.

### 11. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Knowledge Playbook
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/ai-search-geo/generative-engine-optimization-playbook
- Category: AI Search / GEO Optimization
- Difficulty: Advanced | Est. Time: 3 hours
- Schema: TechArticle
- Direct Answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) structures digital assets so AI models like Google Gemini, ChatGPT Search, and Perplexity synthesize and cite brand properties. By embedding factual statistics, quotation hooks, and structured entity definitions, brands dominate conversational AI answer summaries.

### 12. Schema.org FAQPage Structured Entity Architecture
- URL: https://cogwheel-seo-templates.vercel.app/templates/ai-search-geo/faq-structured-entity-framework
- Category: AI Search / GEO Optimization
- Difficulty: Beginner | Est. Time: 1 hour
- Schema: FAQPage
- Direct Answer: The FAQPage structured entity framework pairs machine-readable Schema.org markup with conversational question-and-answer pairs. When structured with concise 40-word answers, verified facts, and zero placeholder tokens, FAQ blocks capture Google People Also Ask snippets and conversational LLM citations effortlessly.
